The '''Bomodons''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="Hunter's Fate" /> [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="SWTORE" /> [[Bomodon]] in the [[Churba sector/Legends|Churba sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Bomodon system/Legends|Bomodon system]]</ref> In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of "[[A Hunter's Fate: Greedo's Tale]] to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> a number of Bomodon [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] were present on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and were witnessed by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] entering [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="Hunter's Fate" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bomodons appeared in the short story "[[A Hunter's Fate: Greedo's Tale]]," written by [[Tom Veitch|Tom]] and [[Martha Veitch]]. The story was published by in [[1995]] as part of the anthology ''[[Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina]]''.<ref name="Hunter's Fate" />
